استعفيا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْفَيَا (istaʕfayā) /is.taʕ.fa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# اُسْتُعْفِيَا (ustuʕfiyā) /us.tuʕ.fi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# اِسْتَعْفِيَا (istaʕfiyā) /is.taʕ.fi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
